# BaselineAlignment

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Vertical baseline positioning for a text span. `Superscript` raises the span above the surrounding baseline; `Subscript` lowers it. The magnitude is derived from the span's own font size unless an explicit `baselineShift` (in points) overrides it.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Values

- `Baseline`: Sits on the surrounding text baseline (default).
- `Superscript`: Raised above the baseline (e.g. footnote markers, ordinals, exponents).
- `Subscript`: Lowered below the baseline (e.g. chemical subscripts).
